purpose.summary: This program is part of the ORCA (JMA Standard Receipt Software) system used by Japanese medical institutions. It generates monthly billing/receipt detail files for hospitalization and self-pay (jibai) claims, editing point-score tables and compiling claim line items. It reads indexed files (RECE82, RECE84, RECE85, RECE86) and produces formatted receipt output including procedure codes, quantities, comments, and diagnostic category breakdowns.
purpose.domain: healthcare / medical billing (Japanese national health insurance receipt processing)

verdict.notes: The file is encoded in latin-1 but the Japanese comments are actually EUC-JP or Shift-JIS, causing mojibake in the displayed text. The COPY statements reference external copybooks (.INC files) that are not included in this file, so full data structure analysis is incomplete. The program is clearly production-grade medical billing software from the well-known Japanese open-source ORCA project. The absence of COMP-3 is somewhat unusual for a billing system but consistent with the observed pic_count and the GnuCOBOL target platform.
